reviewFlags.detail: The named updated addendum and user-provided Street View references were not present; this execution follows the requirements supplied in the conversation.
OSM footprints and GPS points are mapped data, not a new survey. Verify residual offsets using the Google satellite overlay.

South-segment elevations, bridge deck elevations, wall offsets and mural panels remain reference estimates. Northern floor profile uses historical 2013 design spot levels; this is not an as-built elevation survey.
Vegetation density and original artwork are visual interpretations. Google Street View imagery is linked as reference, not baked into textures.
